parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The query token. Set the value to the value of **NextToken** that is returned in the last call.

> You do not need to configure this parameter if you call this operation for the first time.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**, which indicates an Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland) instance.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not configure this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group.

parameters.name: ResourceIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland) instances that you want to query.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the resource to which the tag belongs. Set the value to **INSTANCE**, which indicates an Anti-DDoS Pro instance.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: An array consisting of tags that you want to query. Each tag consists of a tag **key** and a tag **value**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --resource-type INSTANCE --next-token RGuYpqDdKhzXb8C3.D1BwQgc1tMBsoxdGiEKHHUUCf0000 --resource-ids ddoscoo-cn-zz121ogz0000 --tags Value=testvalue Key=testkey --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ddoscoo DescribeTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --Tags.1.Value testvalue --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm2pz25js0000' --NextToken 'RGuYpqDdKhzXb8C3.D1BwQgc1tMBsoxdGiEKHHUUCf0000' --ResourceIds.1 'ddoscoo-cn-zz121ogz0000' --Tags.1.Key testkey --ResourceType INSTANCE --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
